During the hearing on 20.7.2021, learned counsel for MSETCL admitted that though MSETCL had received the notice in the matter in time, it was not able to present its case before the Commission during the proceedings in Petition No. 266/TT/2018. We are of the view that sufficient notice was given to MSETCL but it chose not to file any reply. Therefore, MSETCL‟s contention that it was not represented before the Commission during the proceedings in Petition No.266/TT/2018 as it was not aware of the proceedings is rejected.
